decisions.reason: As a multi-model line that had its own product page in both 2018 and 2019, it reflects enough investment and product-family commitment that management would be inclined to retain it unless failure became unmistakable.

A floor-level shower drainage system sits squarely in the firm's stated strategic direction toward integrated low-profile bathroom drainage, so sunk development and strategic commitment make withdrawal unlikely.

Because this designer shower drainage line was presented as a flagship for the firm's direction, management is especially likely to continue it in order to justify its visible commitment despite any mixed signals in later promotion.
Although it was only mentioned rather than heavily featured, the integrated-slope shower element strongly complements the firm's core system offer, which gives management reasons to persist with it.

The backflow-protected basement floor drain was publicly highlighted, explicitly framed as a developed solution, and then shown on the home page, indicating visible commitment that supports keeping it on the market.

The air-admittance valve appears peripheral to the firm's main bathroom-drainage direction and was only lightly presented, so with lower public commitment management has the least reason to keep escalating resources behind it.
